name: Motorola MT4310 (Newsan; Hisense board, hayward, MediaTek), Argentina
warnings: Without them MemAvailable after boot would be ~349 MB instead of ~315 MB. com.google.android.marvin.talkback also comes back enabled after a reboot but never runs.

Do NOT disable: com.mediatek.* (wwtv.tvcenter is Live TV, HDMI and the Input key's own input panel; tv.service dispatches the YouTube/Prime keys; tvinput is the HDMI/tuner inputs), com.cvte.hotkey.receiver (Disney+ key), com.cvte.tv.infoprovider (device serial), com.cvte.autobacklight, com.airoha.android.btd (Bluetooth).
Never open com.cvte.tv.fac.*, com.cvte.tv.hisensefac, com.cvte.tv.at, com.at.factory.* or mediatek.factorymenu.ui, even to look: on Hisense/CVTE boards that flips a factory-mode flag.
